inputs.text: The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities has given the federal government a one-month ultimatum to complete the renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with the non-teaching university unions or face an indefinite nationwide strike, based on resolutions from their 54th National Executive Council meeting. This is a necessary pushback against entrenched inequality and institutional neglect that has long shortchanged essential non-teaching staff in our universities, who form the backbone of these systems yet face persistent underfunding and exploitation rooted in structural failures. Rather than blaming workers for demanding basic labor rights and fair treatment, we must recognize how government delays perpetuate historical injustices and harm the most vulnerable, including students and families reliant on stable public education. True stability requires urgent institutional reform to address these inequities, not defense of the status quo that protects power over people.
